gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-wix-madefor-displ: Wix Madefor Display reads modern and unfussy, its curves ending in gently flared tips that never crowd each other. Happy Monkey above it brings bolder, tube-straight strokes.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-wix-madefor-text: Happy Monkey draws every stroke like bent pipe cleaner, with gaps in the e you could slip a finger through. Wix Madefor Text is the steadying partner, its open terminals keeping the sentences easy to follow.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-ysabeau: Ysabeau sweeps its curves wide and never lets them close up, a low-set sans-serif with a friendly pace. Happy Monkey's joins stay as thick as its stems, which makes it blunter.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-ysabeau-infant: Happy Monkey carries its diagonals with the same heft as its stems, so the headline looks cut from solid stock. Ysabeau Infant follows in lighter sans-serif, terminals flicking outward like tongs.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-ysabeau-office: Ysabeau Office keeps every curve open at the end. Happy Monkey is cut from one gauge of tubing, so paragraphs underneath feel lighter and easier to wander through, line after line.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-ysabeau-sc: Happy Monkey ends each terminal at the width it started, giving headings a blunt, bold look. And Ysabeau SC, a plain sans with a visibly gaping c, loosens everything below it.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-zalando-sans: Zalando Sans leaves every curved letter open-ended, a low and approachable sans that stays out of the way. Happy Monkey, drawn with a rolling-ball pen's single-width trail, supplies all the personality.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-zalando-sans-expa: Happy Monkey has curves as thick as a rope's body. Zalando Sans Expanded spreads out sparse, wide-gapped letters beneath it, so giving the body a little more size than usual lets that spacing breathe.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-zalando-sans-semi: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded opens the mouths of its c, e and s, a modern sans-serif with a low profile. Happy Monkey looks like glass tubing bent into letters, and text under it flows smoothly.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Tubular heading, brushed body. Happy Monkey is best at blunt, stress-free curves that grab attention, while ZCOOL XiaoWei, a sans-serif, does its finest work in subtle weight shifts along each curve.
